methodology.collection: Every research-paper entry in each configured official publisher listing is parsed without paper or author caps. CoNEXT2025 uses the official program when the accepted-list endpoint is unavailable. Inaccessible editions remain empty and are marked unavailable.
methodology.affiliations: Affiliations are as published, paired only where the official byline states the association. An author before a semicolon without an explicit institution remains unknown. IMC accepted lists do not supply affiliations.
methodology.identity: Author occurrences are preserved per paper; names alone do not establish cross-paper identity.
methodology.graduation: Current degree, enrollment start date, current status, and expected graduation are unknown until separately verified.
methodology.paperLinks: Where the official list has no individual paper link, url remains the real publisher listing URL. No invented fragments or PDF URLs.
methodology.abstracts: Accepted lists do not supply abstracts. Where an official program supplies abstracts, at most300 characters are retained.
